reasoning: 驗證使用者於 TLM 啟用 EPB Maintenance Mode 時，TLM 送出 $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_MaintenanceMode_Req$ = 1 (On)、顯示 Initializing popup、並啟動 T_EPB_MM 計時。關鍵情境為 UI 觸發之送出行為，該訊號 v3 判定解得（BO_162／VAL_ 2 項）。本 Req 之三個結果（送訊號、顯示 popup、起計時）為同一觸發之同時效果，依 §8.2.2 不拆為三條，以多階段 ER（§6.1）表達。T_EPB_MM 之值 35000 ms 取自規格常數表（段 1650 起），不臆造。

tcs.tc_title: EPB Maintenance Mode enabled from HMI → request sent and Initializing popup shown
pre_conditions: The EPB Maintenance Mode menu item is displayed
The EPB Maintenance Mode setting is Off
test_procedure: Select "EPB Maintenance Mode" = "On" to trigger $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_MaintenanceMode_Req$ signal transmission
Read the signal $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_MaintenanceMode_Req$ and check that it is 1 (On)
Read the named UI element "Initializing" pop-up and check that it is displayed
expected_result: The signal $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_MaintenanceMode_Req$ = 1 (On) is registered without a bus error
The named UI element "Initializing" pop-up is displayed
The T_EPB_MM timer is held for 35000 ms
tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.test_item:
TLM receives the value as "On" via signal, $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_MaintenanceMode_Req$ Then TLM shall: Update the EPB Maintenance Mode setting status to On. Activate and display the "Initializing" popup
(HMI On request: outgoing signal, Initializing popup and T_EPB_MM start)

distinguishing_axis.delta: HMI 觸發送出 EPB_MaintenanceMode_Req = 1 (On)，與 -047 之接收 IPC 回報不同向

tcs.remarks: T_EPB_MM = 35000 ms per the spec constant table (paragraph 1650 onwards)
